criteria.L1: Authorized editor can add/remove prerequisites and relationships persist.
criteria.L2: Detail shows both directions with accessible links and current state.
criteria.L3: Self, duplicate, unpublished and cross-board/account links rejected without partial changes or leaks.
criteria.L4: Direct and transitive cycles rejected, including a three-card cycle.
criteria.L5: Preview shows accurate blocked badge/count; filter composes and paginates.
criteria.L6: Every web/JSON/drop closure path refuses blocked cards; unblocked closure works.
criteria.L7: Reopening prerequisites blocks open dependents but does not reopen closed dependents.
criteria.L8: Removing links or deleting prerequisites updates blocking without deleting dependent cards.
criteria.L9: Board moves refused while any link exists; unlinked moves unchanged.
criteria.L10: Account/board access enforced on lists, mutations, filters and crafted requests.
criteria.L11: Concurrent opposite additions cannot produce a cycle; closure/reopening is serializable.
criteria.L12: Existing card workflows and records without dependencies retain behavior.
